These are estimates from structural reasoning about NAS-Bench-201 cell connectivity, not measured values. I didn't have the benchmark data here, so they should be checked against the table before you rely on them. Most interaction claims require consistency across all three datasets and a practical margin, so I've kept the baseline low.
